Welcome to the burrow.

Stay on your paws for as long as you can. Your score grows with distance and the live wheel multiplier.

Jump over rocks
Space / ↑ or tap the burrow
Slide under roots
↓ or select Slide
Take a break
Esc or select Pause

The wheel sets the pace.

Live Squeekchain readings arrive about every 1.5 seconds. ACTIVE raises speed, hazard density, and your multiplier. IDLE gives you a slower run. Settled rounds bring harmless debris.

If the feed drops, you can still play at a gentle pace. The badge shows Offline until readings return.

Scores are local to this browser. No wallet needed.
